# Plant Manager
Plant Manager shift objectives:
1) Maintain a functional, high-performance power generation operation aboard Edison.
2) Ensure the proper safety and management of assets related to particle-accelerated generators and supermatter-based sources.
3) Act in a capacity as a guide for engineering-related work, including queries over broadband or engineering radio.
4) Seek out and fulfill engineering tasks for members of the sector.
## Your Ledger
As the Plant Manager, you will have access to all funds produced via the power transmission point.
By statutory requirement, you are required to keep adequate funds in reserve in the ledger to purchase and set up, at minimum, an entire Tesla containment, particle accelerator, and Tesla coil array. (600~ thousand credits)
You are solely responsible for paying engineers who are directly hired to work aboard Edison. Voluntary work or ad hoc help is not required to be reimbursed.
These funds are primarily for continuing your operation; however, you may withdraw funds to pay yourself or other engineers aboard Edison in accordance with your judgment.
You may open bounties, both for Edison or offering personal labor to other shuttles, at your discretion and unrelated to your benefits as the Plant Manager.
Should the ledger run dry, it falls upon you as the active Plant Manager to alleviate the problems Edison is facing, or to contact supervisors for guidance on how to continue operations.
## General Safety Protocol
The safety of the station should be a paramount priority. Singularities, Tesla Balls, and the Supermatter are all extremely dangerous and can consume the entirety of Edison station and any nearby ships if mismanaged.
If you are planning to be inactive to rest or fall SSD for extremely long periods (8+ hours) and are unsure whether anyone else will be working at Edison during that time, you MUST do the following:
1) Turn off any PA systems for the Tesla and Singularity.
2) Turn off emitters for the Supermatter.
3) Turn off all major auxiliary power-consuming devices, such as the power transmission point, Anti-Matter Fabricator, and the Power to Plasma Converter.
4) Turn off any high-impact thermomachines for the SM or any similar devices in atmospherics.
## Standard Operating Procedures
1) The Plant Manager is expected to uphold the maintenance of Edison as a primary responsibility. This pertains to the general sanitation and habitability of its public spaces.
2) The Plant Manager is not expected to remain at Edison indefinitely; however, they are required to routinely check each active generator once every 2 hours to ensure continued operation.
3) The Plant Manager is not permitted under any circumstances to hand out controlled equipment, such as radiation collectors or Tesla generators.
4) The Plant Manager is permitted to install radiation collectors on their own ship and is required to report any shuttles using radiation collectors without their supervisor's permission to the LSRD.
5) The Plant Manager is not to conduct unrequested audits of civilian shuttles without the owners' permission.
6) The Plant Manager is not to install forbidden atmospheric runes into Edison, nor are they to install radiation collectors for sources other than the singularity or supermatter crystal into Edison's power grid.
7) The Plant Manager is not to reroute the public oxygen and nitrogen repressurization area into Edison for the sake of power generation; these are a public service first and foremost.
